verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical and broken in the same ways. The first dash divider wraps into three stacked rows of dashes, so it no longer reads as a divider. The body copy leaves 'creativity.' orphaned on its own line. The teal 'Great location and modern equipment!' is crammed into three lines, and the booking and website text on the right is too small to read at banner size. B's larger body text runs almost to the top and bottom edges, and its teal block nearly touches the dash line above it, so A's slightly looser spacing makes it marginally better.
